messages:
lucy: Heads-up: launch day checklist for the 'compact' paid funnel tomorrow. main asks: search bids, retarget cadence, creative swap rules, inbound lead mapping to SFDC.
sam_r: timeline + owners? I can own bids during first 6 hours.
diego: creative: rotate 4 short headlines, two CTAs. swap to salesy CTA only for cart abandoners.
priya: frequency cap 2/day for retarget by default. raise to 3/day for users with >2 product views.
ops_lee: tracking template ready. paste:
```
{lpurl}?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=compact_launch_v2&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={adid}&gclid={gclid}
```
lucy: good. we also need utm_variant in the webhook so we can tie leads back to ad variant.
integrations-bot: (automated) note: previous webhook outage on 2025-11-09 caused 12 missing leads.
sam_r: ops_lee can you include lead_score and utm_variant in the payload? and push to the 'inbound-sales' queue if lead_score >= 7.
ops_lee: payload example (staging):
```
{"email":"{{email}}","first_name":"{{first}}","lead_score":"{{score}}","utm_variant":"{{utm_variant}}","source":"compact_launch_v2"}
```
ops_lee: mapping: Compact_Lead_Score__c; Campaign_Variant__c -> utm_variant; Source__c set to compact_launch_v2.
priya: bidding strategy proposal: start -15% on CPC to keep initial CPA under control, unlock +5% increments if CPA < target and CTR > 1.8% per ad group.
sam_r: agree. also enable dynamic sitelinks for top 5 queries. reduces manual ops.
diego: creative swap rule: day0 hero A, day1 hero B (product-inuse), if CTR for hero A < benchmark after 24h then swap early.
lucy: budget ramp: day1 30%, day2 60%, day3 100%. emergency trigger if spend exceeds 110% of burn forecast in 2h -> pause campaigns and page growth leads.
integrations-bot: (automated) webhook smoke test -> 200 OK. SFDC simulated id: 00Q3p00001abcde
ops_lee: adding PagerDuty alert: webhook failures (5xx) >3 in 10m -> oncall@marketing
sam_r: i'll run micro-batches for bids first two hours and post an hourly snapshot in this thread. please keep replies short.
lucy: thanks. i'll upload final assets to Drive and drop the link here when ready. :rocket:
diego: uploaded: compact_hero_v2.png, headline_pack_v3.docx
priya: confirmed ad copy approved. launching at 09:00 PT Tomorrow.
